package converted

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"golang.org/x/net/html"
)

type heroFailWriter struct{ err error }

func (w heroFailWriter) Write([]byte) (int, error) { return 0, w.err }

func fixtureHero() Hero {
	return Hero{
		LogoLightURL: "/fixture/images/logo-light.svg", LogoDarkURL: "/fixture/images/logo-dark.svg", LogoAlt: "Fixture company",
		Announcement: "Synthetic product announcement", AnnouncementLabel: "Read announcement", AnnouncementURL: "/fixture/announcement",
		Heading: "Data for a synthetic business", Introduction: "A bounded fixture introduction for the adapted hero.",
		PrimaryLabel: "Get started", PrimaryURL: "/fixture/start", SecondaryLabel: "Learn more", SecondaryURL: "https://example.test/learn",
		ImageURL: "/fixture/images/hero.jpg", ImageAlt: "Colleagues reviewing a synthetic plan",
	}
}

func requireHeroError(t *testing.T, data Hero) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, constructor := range []func(Hero) (interface {
		Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
	}, error){
		func(data Hero) (interface {
			Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
		}, error) {
			return NewHero(data)
		},
		func(data Hero) (interface {
			Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
		}, error) {
			return NewHeroEnhanced(data)
		},
	} {
		if component, err := constructor(data); err == nil || component != nil {
			t.Fatal("invalid hero accepted")
		}
	}
}

func renderHero(t *testing.T, component interface {
	Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
}) string {
	t.Helper()
	var out bytes.Buffer
	if err := component.Render(context.Background(), &out); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return out.String()
}

func heroElements(t *testing.T, markup, name string) []*html.Node {
	t.Helper()
	doc, err := html.Parse(strings.NewReader(markup))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var found []*html.Node
	var walk func(*html.Node)
	walk = func(node *html.Node) {
		if node.Type == html.ElementNode && node.Data == name {
			found = append(found, node)
		}
		for child := node.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
			walk(child)
		}
	}
	walk(doc)
	return found
}

func heroNodeAttr(node *html.Node, name string) (string, bool) {
	for _, attr := range node.Attr {
		if attr.Namespace == "" && attr.Key == name {
			return attr.Val, true
		}
	}
	return "", false
}

func TestHeroConstructorsRenderEscapedSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	for _, constructor := range []func(Hero) (interface {
		Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
	}, error){
		func(data Hero) (interface {
			Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
		}, error) {
			return NewHero(data)
		},
		func(data Hero) (interface {
			Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
		}, error) {
			return NewHeroEnhanced(data)
		},
	} {
		data := fixtureHero()
		data.Heading = `<script>unsafe()</script> & "fixture"`
		data.Introduction = `<img src=x> bounded introduction`
		component, err := constructor(data)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		data.Heading = "mutated after construction"
		markup := renderHero(t, component)
		if strings.Contains(markup, "<script>") || strings.Contains(markup, "<img src=x>") || strings.Contains(markup, data.Heading) {
			t.Fatal("text binding injected markup or observed caller mutation")
		}
		for _, escaped := range []string{"&lt;script&gt;unsafe()&lt;/script&gt;", "&lt;img src=x&gt;"} {
			if !strings.Contains(markup, escaped) {
				t.Fatalf("escaped text missing %q", escaped)
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestHeroConstructorsBindRoutesImagesAndAltSemantics(t *testing.T) {
	constructors := []func(Hero) (interface {
		Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
	}, error){
		func(data Hero) (interface {
			Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
		}, error) {
			return NewHero(data)
		},
		func(data Hero) (interface {
			Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
		}, error) {
			return NewHeroEnhanced(data)
		},
	}
	for _, constructor := range constructors {
		data := fixtureHero()
		data.ImageAlt = `"><script>unsafe()</script> & "quoted" fixture`
		component, err := constructor(data)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		markup := renderHero(t, component)
		links, images := heroElements(t, markup, "a"), heroElements(t, markup, "img")
		if len(links) != 3 || len(images) != 3 || len(heroElements(t, markup, "script")) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("rendered elements: links=%d images=%d", len(links), len(images))
		}
		for i, want := range []string{data.AnnouncementURL, data.PrimaryURL, data.SecondaryURL} {
			if got, ok := heroNodeAttr(links[i], "href"); !ok || got != want {
				t.Fatalf("link %d = %q, want %q", i, got, want)
			}
		}
		for i, want := range []struct{ src, alt string }{
			{data.LogoLightURL, data.LogoAlt},
			{data.LogoDarkURL, data.LogoAlt},
			{data.ImageURL, data.ImageAlt},
		} {
			gotSrc, srcOK := heroNodeAttr(images[i], "src")
			gotAlt, altOK := heroNodeAttr(images[i], "alt")
			if !srcOK || !altOK || gotSrc != want.src || gotAlt != want.alt {
				t.Fatalf("image %d = src %q alt %q", i, gotSrc, gotAlt)
			}
		}

		data = fixtureHero()
		data.ImageDecorative, data.ImageAlt = true, ""
		component, err = constructor(data)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		images = heroElements(t, renderHero(t, component), "img")
		if len(images) != 3 {
			t.Fatal("decorative hero image missing")
		}
		if alt, ok := heroNodeAttr(images[2], "alt"); !ok || alt != "" {
			t.Fatal("decorative hero image did not retain empty alt")
		}
	}
}

func TestHeroRejectsInvalidTextFields(t *testing.T) {
	for _, field := range []struct {
		name  string
		limit int
	}{
		{"LogoAlt", 256}, {"Announcement", 600}, {"AnnouncementLabel", 100},
		{"Heading", 160}, {"Introduction", 1200}, {"PrimaryLabel", 100}, {"SecondaryLabel", 100},
	} {
		for _, bad := range []string{"", " ", "bad\ncontrol", string([]byte{0xff}), strings.Repeat("x", field.limit+1)} {
			data := fixtureHero()
			reflect.ValueOf(&data).Elem().FieldByName(field.name).SetString(bad)
			requireHeroError(t, data)
		}
	}
}

func TestHeroAcceptsExactByteBoundsAndRejectsOneAbove(t *testing.T) {
	data := fixtureHero()
	for _, field := range []struct {
		name  string
		limit int
	}{
		{"LogoAlt", 256}, {"Announcement", 600}, {"AnnouncementLabel", 100},
		{"Heading", 160}, {"Introduction", 1200}, {"PrimaryLabel", 100}, {"SecondaryLabel", 100}, {"ImageAlt", 512},
	} {
		reflect.ValueOf(&data).Elem().FieldByName(field.name).SetString(strings.Repeat("x", field.limit))
	}
	exactURL := "/" + strings.Repeat("u", 2047)
	for _, field := range []string{"LogoLightURL", "LogoDarkURL", "AnnouncementURL", "PrimaryURL", "SecondaryURL", "ImageURL"} {
		reflect.ValueOf(&data).Elem().FieldByName(field).SetString(exactURL)
	}
	for _, constructor := range []func(Hero) (interface {
		Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
	}, error){
		func(data Hero) (interface {
			Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
		}, error) {
			return NewHero(data)
		},
		func(data Hero) (interface {
			Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
		}, error) {
			return NewHeroEnhanced(data)
		},
	} {
		if component, err := constructor(data); err != nil || component == nil {
			t.Fatalf("exact bounds rejected: %v", err)
		}
	}

	tooLong := fixtureHero()
	tooLong.Heading = strings.Repeat("x", 161)
	requireHeroError(t, tooLong)
	tooLong = fixtureHero()
	tooLong.ImageAlt = strings.Repeat("x", 513)
	requireHeroError(t, tooLong)
	for _, field := range []string{"LogoLightURL", "LogoDarkURL", "AnnouncementURL", "PrimaryURL", "SecondaryURL", "ImageURL"} {
		tooLong = fixtureHero()
		reflect.ValueOf(&tooLong).Elem().FieldByName(field).SetString("/" + strings.Repeat("u", 2048))
		requireHeroError(t, tooLong)
	}
}

func TestHeroRejectsInvalidURLsWithoutExposingValues(t *testing.T) {
	fields := []string{"LogoLightURL", "LogoDarkURL", "AnnouncementURL", "PrimaryURL", "SecondaryURL", "ImageURL"}
	badURLs := []string{"", "#", "relative", "//example.test/path", `\\example.test\path`, "/bad\\path", "/%2fexample.test", "/bad%5cpath", "/bad%0apath", "https://user@example.test/path", "https:opaque", "https://example.test:0/path", "https://example.test:65536/path", "https://example.test:/path", "http://example.test/path", "javascript:alert(1)", "data:text/plain,x", "blob:https://example.test/id", "file:///tmp/x", strings.Repeat("/", 2049), string([]byte{0xff})}
	for _, field := range fields {
		for _, bad := range badURLs {
			data := fixtureHero()
			reflect.ValueOf(&data).Elem().FieldByName(field).SetString(bad)
			for _, constructor := range []func(Hero) (interface {
				Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
			}, error){
				func(data Hero) (interface {
					Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
				}, error) {
					return NewHero(data)
				},
				func(data Hero) (interface {
					Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
				}, error) {
					return NewHeroEnhanced(data)
				},
			} {
				component, err := constructor(data)
				if err == nil || component != nil {
					t.Fatalf("accepted invalid %s", field)
				}
				if bad != "" && strings.Contains(err.Error(), bad) {
					t.Fatalf("error exposed invalid %s", field)
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestHeroImageAltContract(t *testing.T) {
	data := fixtureHero()
	data.ImageDecorative, data.ImageAlt = true, ""
	if _, err := NewHero(data); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, mutate := range []func(*Hero){
		func(data *Hero) { data.ImageDecorative, data.ImageAlt = true, "not empty" },
		func(data *Hero) { data.ImageAlt = "" },
		func(data *Hero) { data.ImageAlt = "bad\talt" },
		func(data *Hero) { data.ImageAlt = strings.Repeat("x", 513) },
		func(data *Hero) { data.ImageAlt = string([]byte{0xff}) },
	} {
		data := fixtureHero()
		mutate(&data)
		requireHeroError(t, data)
	}
}

func TestHeroCancellationAndWriterFailure(t *testing.T) {
	for _, constructor := range []func(Hero) (interface {
		Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
	}, error){
		func(data Hero) (interface {
			Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
		}, error) {
			return NewHero(data)
		},
		func(data Hero) (interface {
			Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
		}, error) {
			return NewHeroEnhanced(data)
		},
	} {
		component, err := constructor(fixtureHero())
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		cancel()
		var out bytes.Buffer
		if err := component.Render(ctx, &out); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || out.Len() != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("pre-cancelled render: err=%v bytes=%d", err, out.Len())
		}
		sentinel := errors.New("writer failure")
		if err := component.Render(context.Background(), heroFailWriter{sentinel}); !errors.Is(err, sentinel) {
			t.Fatal("writer error lost")
		}
	}
}
